cohort: Children with omphalocele, identified from approximately 16 million pregnancies (including live births, stillbirths, and elective terminations for fetal anomalies) across 23 birth defect surveillance systems in 18 countries.
finding: The prevalence of omphalocele was 2.6 per 10,000 births and remained stable from 2000-2012, with approximately one-third of affected children not surviving early childhood.
